sections.title: Items
sections.note: The Items screen. An item's upgrades are its tiers.

tiers.name: Fishing Rod
tiers.howTo: Uli gives you the rod Colin made once you win her cradle back from the monkey in Ordon Village, on the first day.

tiers.name: Coral Earring
tiers.howTo: Prince Ralis gives it to you at his father's grave behind Kakariko Graveyard, after the Arbiter's Grounds. It hooks onto the rod as bait for the Reekfish.

items.name: Slingshot
items.howTo: Buy it for 30 Rupees on the first day.

items.name: Lantern
items.howTo: Coro gives it to you outside his hut after the Faron Twilight. If the monkey steals it, chase her through the woods to get it back.
items.notes: Coro sells Lantern Oil; his Bottle is in the Bottles tab.

items.name: Gale Boomerang
items.howTo: Defeat Ook, the temple's mini-boss.

items.name: Iron Boots
items.howTo: Beat Bo at sumo after the Gorons stop you on Death Mountain.

items.name: Hero's Bow
items.howTo: In the chest after Dangoro, the mini-boss. It comes with a quiver of 30 arrows.
items.notes: With a Bomb Bag you can fire Bomb Arrows; with the Hawkeye, zoom in.

items.name: Hawkeye
items.howTo: Goes on sale for 100 Rupees after you finish Talo's target practice on the Kakariko lookout tower.
items.notes: Talo's practice is in Sidequests & Collections and its Piece of Heart in Heart Pieces.

items.name: Bombs
items.howTo: Barnes sells his first Bomb Bag, full of 30 Bombs, for 120 Rupees after the Goron Mines.

tiers.name: Bombs
tiers.howTo: Buy the first Bomb Bag from Barnes for 120 Rupees after the Goron Mines.

tiers.name: Water Bombs
tiers.howTo: Barnes stocks them once Lanayru is restored. They explode underwater; a bag holds 15.

tiers.name: Bomblings
tiers.howTo: Barnes stocks them later in the story (his letter "Rare Item in Stock"). They scuttle forward before exploding; a bag holds 10.

items.notes: Bomb Bags are in the Upgrades tab.

tiers.name: Clawshot
tiers.howTo: The Lakebed Temple's dungeon item, after the Deku Toad.

tiers.name: Double Clawshots
tiers.howTo: A second Clawshot from the City in the Sky, after the Aeralfos.

items.name: Spinner
items.howTo: Defeat the Death Sword, the mini-boss.

items.name: Ball and Chain
items.howTo: Defeat Darkhammer, the mini-boss.

tiers.name: Dominion Rod
tiers.howTo: The Temple of Time's dungeon item, after the Darknut. It loses its power when you leave the temple.

tiers.name: Restored power
tiers.howTo: Show Shad the Ancient Sky Book under Renado's sanctuary in Kakariko; the book's first character wakes the rod again, and it moves the Owl Statues.

items.name: Horse Call
items.howTo: Ilia gives it to you once her memory comes back (Main Quest, Ilia's memory). Blow it in Hyrule Field to call Epona.

tiers.name: Ancient Sky Book
tiers.howTo: Impaz gives it to you in the Hidden Village, after Ilia's charm.

tiers.name: Sky Book
tiers.howTo: Fill in the six missing sky characters from under the Owl Statues across Hyrule (Main Quest, Sky characters).

items.name: Ooccoo
items.howTo: Ooccoo sits in a pot in the Forest Temple (and in each dungeon after). Use her to warp out of a dungeon and her son, Ooccoo Jr., to warp back.
items.notes: Her letters, two of which can be missed, are in Sidequests & Collections.

sections.title: Equipment
sections.note: Swords, shields and clothing, as on the Collection screen.

items.name: Ordon Sword
items.howTo: As a wolf, after escaping Hyrule Castle, take it from Rusl's house. Midna carries it until Link is human again.
items.notes: The Wooden Sword you deliver to Talo before this isn't kept.

tiers.name: Master Sword
tiers.howTo: Draw it from its pedestal in the Sacred Grove, after the Lakebed Temple. It breaks Zant's curse.

tiers.name: Light-filled Master Sword
tiers.howTo: The two Sols fill it with light in the Palace of Twilight.

items.name: Ordon Shield
items.howTo: As a wolf, knock it down from the window of Jaggle and Pergie's loft.
items.notes: It can burn, and there's no other Ordon Shield after that; replace it with a Wooden Shield.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.howTo: Buy it for 50 Rupees (also sold at the Goron shop on Death Mountain). It can burn.
items.notes: You can't buy one while you hold a Wooden or Ordon Shield.

items.name: Hylian Shield
items.howTo: Buy it for 200 Rupees once Malo opens the shop, after Colin is rescued. It never burns.

items.name: Hero's Clothes
items.howTo: The Light Spirit Faron gives them to you when the Faron Twilight lifts.

items.name: Zora Armor
items.howTo: Queen Rutela's ghost gives it to you at King Zora's grave, after you escort Prince Ralis to Kakariko. Breathe underwater and swim freely.

items.name: Magic Armor
items.howTo: Buy it for 598 Rupees once the Malo Mart donations open the Castle Town branch. It drains Rupees instead of hearts.
items.notes: The donations are in Sidequests & Collections. Chudley's price for it was 100,000 Rupees.

sections.title: Upgrades
sections.note: Wallets, quivers and bomb bags. Bomb Bags come in any order.

items.name: Wallet
items.notes: The Wallet you start with holds 300 Rupees. HD: 500, 1,000 and 2,000, and the Cave of Shadows adds the 9,999-Rupee Colossal Wallet (HD tab).

tiers.name: Big Wallet
tiers.howTo: Agitha gives it for your first Golden Bug. Holds 600 Rupees.

tiers.name: Giant Wallet
tiers.howTo: Agitha gives it for all 24 Golden Bugs. Holds 1,000 Rupees.

items.name: Quiver
items.notes: The quiver that comes with the Hero's Bow holds 30 arrows.

tiers.name: Big Quiver
tiers.howTo: Win Purlo's STAR Game in Castle Town (Clawshot round, 10 Rupees). Holds 60 arrows.

tiers.name: Giant Quiver
tiers.howTo: Win the STAR Game's Double Clawshot round (15 Rupees). Holds 100 arrows.

items.name: Bomb Bag: Barnes
items.howTo: Buy it, full of Bombs, for 120 Rupees after the Goron Mines.

items.name: Bomb Bag: Iza
items.area: Iza's Boat Rental, Upper Zora's River
items.howTo: Iza lends you a Bomb Bag to clear the rocks from the river with Bomb Arrows from her canoe; it's yours to keep.

items.name: Bomb Bag: Zora's Domain Goron
items.howTo: In the Zora Armor and Iron Boots, sink to the bottom of the throne room pool and blow up the old molten rock with a Water Bomb. The Goron trapped inside gives you a Bomb Bag.

items.name: Giant Bomb Bag
items.area: Iza's Boat Rental, Upper Zora's River
items.howTo: Score 25 or more points in Iza's Rapid Ride (20 Rupees). It doubles every bag: 60 Bombs, 30 Water Bombs or 20 Bomblings.

items.name: Sera's Bottle
items.howTo: On the first day, catch fish with the Fishing Rod behind Jaggle's house until Sera's cat runs home with one. Go into the shop: Sera gives you the Bottle, half full of Milk.
items.notes: GameCube and Wii: the cat needs two fish; HD: one.

items.name: Coro's Bottle
items.howTo: Coro sells a Bottle of Lantern Oil for 100 Rupees after the Faron Twilight.

items.name: Fishing Hole Bottle
items.area: Hena's Fishing Hole, Upper Zora's River
items.howTo: Don't rent a canoe: walk round to the closed-off pool by the bridge on the east side (the DON'T LITTER sign) and cast your own Fishing Rod there until you reel in the Bottle.

items.name: Jovani's Bottle
items.howTo: Bring Jovani 20 Poe Souls.
items.notes: HD: he also gives the Ghost Lantern. The Poe Souls tracker counts the souls.

items.name: Ghost Lantern
items.howTo: HD only: Jovani gives it with his Bottle for 20 Poe Souls. It glows while an Imp Poe is in the area, day or night, and needs no oil.

items.name: Colossal Wallet
items.howTo: HD only: clear the Cave of Shadows (Wolf Link amiibo) with the Giant Wallet. Holds 9,999 Rupees.
items.notes: Cleared with a smaller wallet, the cave gives the next size up instead. The floors are in the Cave of Ordeals tracker.
